svg.title: MedScale medium-size icon - dark
svg.desc: Optical medium master (48 to 64 px): the same symbol path on the near-black rounded tile with a tighter crop.
svg.metadata: MedScale identity. Symbol: founder-supplied mark of 2026-11-05, first-party vector trace as one filled path. Wordmark: founder-approved 2026-10-22, filled outlines drawn from Plus Jakarta Sans (SIL OFL 1.1) with custom spacing. No font file is embedded.
